comment: Machine-read acceptance registry consumed by run_ab.py. Accepted != invisible: the harness renders every match as KNOWN-DEVIATION, hard-fails if a deviation grows beyond its bound, and hard-fails on any unregistered violation. open_findings are NOT acceptances - they are owner-pending items rendered loudly with a distinct non-zero exit code.

deviations.root_cause: Two pre-existing excluded-zone-logic mechanisms, fully attributed by the per-zone delta ledger (diagnostics/g0/stop3_ledger.py): (1) +51.7ms zone_too_small stale-delta tripwire on T15 (corner_analysis.py:1500-1507 keeps the pre-clamp delta_change when the clamped zone is <50m); (2) -34.1ms uncovered head segment [0.0,4.6m] (calculate_straight_segments emits no straight before the first corner zone; legacy T1 zone happened to start at 0.0). G0 authored or altered neither mechanism; the honest substrate moved zone boundaries by one sample onto both tripwires.
deviations.acceptance_fork: fork 1 via OR-clause (ledger attribution complete within 5ms; legacy closes at 0.0000s on the identical pair)

9.classification: gap-overlap: NOR car-stream dropout 1642-1721m (the Tunnel, dt=1.08s ratio=4.5) inside the T9 analysis zone 1406-1721m; detection over a measured acquisition hole is indeterminate by definition

11.classification: smoothing-driven (detector gate): forensics window-sweep shows the shift collapses to <0.2m at decel smoothing window=1, so the detector sample-count smoothing window is the cause; the LEC dropout 2091-2116m overlap is incidental, not causal

14.classification: mixed/structural (detector gate): forensics window-sweep shows the shift persists at decel smoothing window=1, so it is not a pure smoothing artifact (partially structural); the NOR dropout 2408-2466m overlap is also present

deviations.exclude_but_preserve: registered corners stay in the per-corner diff table with their shifts and classification; they are excluded only from the Phase-5 pass/fail aggregate
deviations.root_cause: acquisition-gap overlap (car-stream dropouts measured by the G0 gap law)

10.classification: smoothing-driven: shift collapses to <0.2m at decel smoothing window=1; real braking corner, no gap overlap; registration delta -0.088m, apex identical, legacy bp on a real 'car' row

17.classification: smoothing-driven: shift collapses to <0.2m at window=1; legacy bp on an interpolated 'pos' row; 1.00x the actual straddling native gap (the 1.58x-median figure was a jitter artifact)
